part.text:
Fixed in `crates/printer/src/util.rs`: multiline replacements now stop at the current match's line range instead of copying the remaining look-ahead buffer, and matches beginning past that range are ignored.

Validated with `cargo test --offline -p grep-printer` (94 passed) and `cargo test --offline --test integration` (274 passed). The reproduction now outputs only `X\n`.
